content: Rifampin increases the metabolism of carvedilol, potentially reducing its effectiveness. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin reduces caspofungin levels by increasing its metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Cenobamate decreases rifampin levels or effects by influencing hepatic enzyme CYP2B6 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. The dose of CYP2B6 substrates may need to be increased when co-administered with cenobamate. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of cevimeline by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of chlordiazepoxide by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of chloroquine by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin increases the toxicity of cholic acid by reducing its elimination. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Avoid using inhibitors of the bile salt efflux pump (BSEP), as this may exacerbate the accumulation of conjugated bile salts in the liver, leading to clinical symptoms. If concomitant use is unavoidable, monitor serum transaminases and bilirubin levels. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of citalopram by affecting hepatic enzymes CYP2C19 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of clarithromycin by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of clomipramine by affecting hepatic enzymes CYP1A2 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of clonazepam by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of clorazepate by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Clotrimazole increases rifampin levels or effects through an unspecified interaction mechanism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Concomitant use of cotrimoxazole increases rifampin concentrations, which may elevate the risk of toxicity. Monitor for adverse reactions during co-administration. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of clozapine by affecting hepatic enzyme CYP1A2 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of conjugated estrogens by influencing the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of cortisone by affecting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin decreases crizotinib levels by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Crizotinib increases rifampin levels by influencing the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of cyclophosphamide by affecting hepatic enzymes CYP2B6 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of cyclosporine by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism and the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Danicopan increases rifampin levels or effects by affecting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are advised. Danicopan also increases plasma concentrations of P-gp substrates, necessitating dose reduction of P-gp substrates where minimal concentration changes may lead to serious adverse reactions. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of dantrolene by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin decreases daprodustat levels or effects through other mechanisms. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Monitor hemoglobin levels and adjust the daprodustat dose when initiating or discontinuing CYP2C8 inducers during treatment. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of dapsone by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin decreases daunorubicin levels by influencing the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces deferasirox levels through other mechanisms. Avoid concomitant use of potent UGT inducers with deferasirox. If co-administration is required, consider increasing the initial dose of deferasirox to 30 mg/kg and monitor ferritin levels and clinical response. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of deflazacort by affecting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of dexamethasone by influencing the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of dexlansoprazole by affecting hepatic enzymes CYP3A4 and CYP2C19 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of diazepam (buccal and intranasal) by influencing hepatic enzymes CYP2C19 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers may increase the rate of diazepam elimination, potentially reducing its efficacy. Rifampin decreases digoxin levels by affecting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter and increasing metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of disopyramide by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin decreases docetaxel levels by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism and the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces dolutegravir levels by increasing metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Increase the dolutegravir dosage when co-administering with strong UGT1A/CYP3A4 inducers. Consider alternative treatments in patients with integrase strand transfer inhibitor (INSTI)-associated resistance, as concomitant use may result in therapeutic failure and resistance development. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of donepezil by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of doxepin cream by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin decreases doxorubicin levels by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism and the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of dronabinol by influencing hepatic enzymes CYP2C9/10 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin decreases dutasteride levels or effects by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of duvelisib by influencing the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin decreases efavirenz levels by affecting hepatic enzymes CYP3A4 and CYP2B6 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces elafibranor levels by increasing metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin increases elagolix levels through other mechanisms while reducing its levels by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Limit the concomitant use of elagolix 150 mg daily with rifampin to six months. Rifampin decreases eltrombopag levels by affecting hepatic enzymes CYP1A2 and CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Eltrombopag increases rifampin levels by reducing metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces enfortumab vedotin levels by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin decreases eplerenone levels by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces erlotinib levels by influencing the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin decreases escitalopram levels by affecting hepatic enzymes CYP2C19 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces esomeprazole levels by influencing hepatic enzymes CYP3A4 and CYP2C19 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin decreases estradiol levels by affecting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of estrogens (conjugated, synthetic, esterified) by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism and the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are advised. Hormonal contraceptive efficacy may be reduced; alternative or backup contraception is recommended during and for 28 days after discontinuing enzyme inducers. Rifampin decreases lidocaine levels by affecting hepatic enzyme CYP1A2 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rifampin reduces linagliptin levels by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism and the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are advised. Alternative treatments are strongly recommended.
